abilities.super-luck: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.
abilities.aftermath: Damages the attacker if it contacts the Pokémon with a finishing hit.
abilities.anticipation: The Pokémon can sense an opposing Pokémon’s dangerous moves.
abilities.forewarn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.
abilities.unaware: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target Pokémon’s stat changes.
abilities.water-absorb: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move, instead of taking damage.
abilities.tinted-lens: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.
abilities.filter: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
abilities.slow-start: For five turns, the Pokémon’s Attack and Speed stats are halved.
abilities.scrappy: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.
abilities.storm-drain: Draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of being hit by Water-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.
abilities.solid-rock: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
abilities.honey-gather: The Pokémon may gather Honey after a battle.
abilities.frisk: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can check an opposing Pokémon’s held item.
abilities.oblivious: The Pokémon is oblivious, and that keeps it from being infatuated or falling for taunts.
abilities.multitype: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the Plate or Z-Crystal it holds.
abilities.flower-gift: Boosts the Attack and Sp. Def stats of itself and allies when it is sunny.
abilities.sheer-force: Removes additional effects to increase the power of moves when attacking.
abilities.defiant: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat sharply when its stats are lowered.
abilities.defeatist: Halves the Pokémon’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats when its HP becomes half or less.
abilities.weak-armor: Physical attacks to the Pokémon lower its Defense stat but sharply raise its Speed stat.
abilities.multiscale: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes when its HP is full.
abilities.compound-eyes: The Pokémon’s compound eyes boost its accuracy.
abilities.moody: Raises one stat sharply and lowers another every turn.
abilities.big-pecks: Protects the Pokémon from Defense-lowering effects.
abilities.insomnia: The Pokémon is suffering from insomnia and cannot fall asleep.
abilities.infiltrator: Passes through the opposing Pokémon’s barrier, substitute, and the like and strikes.
abilities.mummy: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Mummy.
abilities.moxie: The Pokémon shows moxie, and that boosts the Attack stat after knocking out any Pokémon.
abilities.justified: Being hit by a Dark-type move boosts the Attack stat of the Pokémon, for justice.
abilities.rattled: Dark-, Ghost-, and Bug-type moves scare the Pokémon and boost its Speed stat.
abilities.magic-bounce: Reflects status moves, instead of getting hit by them.
abilities.sap-sipper: Boosts the Attack stat if hit by a Grass-type move, instead of taking damage.
abilities.sand-force: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.
abilities.iron-barbs: Inflicts damage to the attacker on contact with iron barbs.
abilities.aroma-veil: Protects itself and its allies from attacks that limit their move choices.
abilities.flower-veil: Ally Grass-type Pokémon are protected from status conditions and the lowering of their stats.
abilities.protean: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use.
abilities.fur-coat: Halves the damage from physical moves.
abilities.immunity: The immune system of the Pokémon prevents it from getting poisoned.
abilities.competitive: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat sharply when a stat is lowered.
abilities.strong-jaw: The Pokémon’s strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.
abilities.refrigerate: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
abilities.stance-change: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move, and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.
abilities.gale-wings: Gives priority to Flying-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is full.
abilities.grass-pelt: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat in Grassy Terrain.
abilities.flash-fire: Powers up the Pokémon’s Fire-type moves if it’s hit by one.
abilities.symbiosis: The Pokémon passes its item to an ally that has used up an item.
abilities.pixilate: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
abilities.aura-break: The effects of “Aura” Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.
abilities.shield-dust: This Pokémon’s dust blocks the additional effects of attacks taken.
abilities.stamina: Boosts the Defense stat when hit by an attack.
abilities.wimp-out: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
abilities.emergency-exit: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
abilities.water-compaction: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat sharply when hit by a Water-type move.
abilities.merciless: The Pokémon’s attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.
abilities.shields-down: When its HP becomes half or less, the Pokémon’s shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.
abilities.stakeout: Doubles the damage dealt to the target’s replacement if the target switches out.
abilities.water-bubble: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves done to the Pokémon and prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.
abilities.own-tempo: This Pokémon has its own tempo, and that prevents it from becoming confused.
abilities.berserk: Boosts the Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to become half or less.
abilities.slush-rush: Boosts the Pokémon’s Speed stat in a hailstorm.
abilities.long-reach: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.
abilities.liquid-voice: All sound-based moves become Water-type moves.
abilities.triage: Gives priority to a healing move.
abilities.schooling: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.
abilities.disguise: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.
abilities.suction-cups: This Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot to negate all moves and items that force switching out.
abilities.corrosion: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it’s a Steel or Poison type.
abilities.comatose: It’s always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack without waking up.
abilities.queenly-majesty: Its majesty pressures the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.
abilities.innards-out: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.
abilities.dancer: When another Pokémon uses a dance move, it can use a dance move following it regardless of its Speed.
abilities.battery: Powers up ally Pokémon’s special moves.
abilities.fluffy: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.
abilities.dazzling: Surprises the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.
abilities.intimidate: The Pokémon intimidates opposing Pokémon upon entering battle, lowering their Attack stat.
abilities.soul-heart: Boosts its Sp. Atk stat every time a Pokémon faints.
abilities.receiver: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
abilities.beast-boost: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.
abilities.rks-system: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.
abilities.electric-surge: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
abilities.psychic-surge: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
abilities.misty-surge: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
abilities.grassy-surge: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
abilities.shadow-tag: This Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon’s shadow to prevent it from escaping.
abilities.full-metal-body: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.
abilities.shadow-shield: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.
abilities.prism-armor: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
abilities.rough-skin: This Pokémon inflicts damage with its rough skin to the attacker on contact.
abilities.wonder-guard: Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.
abilities.levitate: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.
abilities.effect-spore: Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on its attacker.
abilities.synchronize: The attacker will receive the same status condition if it inflicts a burn, poison, or paralysis to the Pokémon.
abilities.clear-body: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.
abilities.speed-boost: Its Speed stat is boosted every turn.
abilities.lightning-rod: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of being hit by Electric-type moves, it boosts its Sp. Atk.
abilities.serene-grace: Boosts the likelihood of additional effects occurring when attacking.
abilities.illuminate: Raises the likelihood of meeting wild Pokémon by illuminating the surroundings.
